newsitem.title: PERU: Shots heard at site of Lima hostage drama.
newsitem.headline: Shots heard at site of Lima hostage drama.

text.p: Two single shots were heard on Thursday from inside the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, where Peruvian leftist rebels were holding about 400 of hostages.
The shots, at 4.30 p.m. EST (2130 GMT), were followed by silence.

The shots followed a calm night and marked the first incident inside the residence since an explosion on Wednesday. There was no information about the shots and there were no immediate reports of any injuries.
Two Red Cross officials were inside the compound at the time of the shots.
The Red Cross has been leading negotiations with the rebels and taking food and medical supplies to those inside.

The guerrillas seized the residence on Tuesday night and have threatened to kill their hostages, who include foreign diplomats and Peruvian officials, if their demands for the release of jailed comrades are not met.
